name: falcon-ea2b14d3-blind28-ots
instr:
# Falcon: restoring drifted framework behaviour without a test suite

A web service built on this library takes in what a client sends, decides which piece of code serves each address, and builds what goes back. Having pulled this checkout, we find a great deal of that ordinary behaviour has drifted, and we have collected everything we could reproduce from the outside. Nothing about the protocol changed and nothing about our own calling code changed. The repository has received 28 separate undocumented edits.

Reading what a client sent. Small named values carried in on a single line are now dropped when the name has whitespace in front of it: a header reading `x=1;bad{stray=bar; x=2;x=3 ; x=4;` used to yield all four values for `x` and now yields only some of them, and one sent over several lines with an entry like `_ga =GA1.2.332347814...` cannot be looked up under that name at all. Asking for the chain of forwarded client addresses gives the entries with their leading spaces still attached, so `192.0.2.43, 2001:db8:cafe::17,unknown, _hidden, 203.0.113.60` comes back with every item but the first one padded; this misbehaves identically on blocking and on asynchronous services, and it looks like two independent edits, since repairing one leaves the other wrong.
